newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-LIST OF REPLACED SERIE A COACHES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LIST OF REPLACED SERIE A COACHES.

text.p: The following is a list of the serie A coaches replaced in Italy this season, including Monday's sacking of Napoli's Luigi Simone.

Fourteen serie B coaches have also lost their jobs. 1. CAGLIARI -- Oct 21, Uruguayan Gregorio Perez dismissed and replaced by former Roma coach Carlo Mazzone. 2. REGGIANA -- Nov 25, Romanian Mircea Lucescu fired and replaced by Francesco Oddo. 3. MILAN -- Dec 1, Uruguayan Oscar Washington Tabarez resigns and is replaced by former Italy coach Arrigo Sacchi. 4. PERUGIA -- Dec 29, Giovanni Galeone dismissed and replaced by former Parma coach Nevio Scala 5. LAZIO -- Jan 28, Czech Zdenek Zeman dismissed and replaced temporarily by club president Dino Zoff until Swede Sven Goran Eriksson arrives next season. 6. ROMA -- April 7, Argentine Carlos Bianchi fired and replaced by 74-year-old Swede Nils Liedholm and Ezio Sella until permanent replacement is found. 7. NAPOLI -- April 21, Simoni.
